extension.summary: Control a Denon AV receiver from Kodi, with sound presets per media type
extension.description: Volume, mute, power, inputs and sound modes for Denon AV receivers on the LAN, and receiver presets chosen by what's playing (sound mode, Audyssey, dialogue, levels, dynamic range), restored when playback stops. Works alongside Home Assistant and other controllers: commands go over the receiver's HTTP interface and live updates come from HEOS. Publishes receiver state as skin properties (Window(Home).Property(Denon.*)).
